Meet Gemini Omni 1.2 Flash ⚡️

We’ve made the model more cost-effective, bumped the video generation and editing limit up to 15 seconds, and made updates to how scenes hold together over time. We've also given character speech an upgrade, reduced visual glitches like jump cuts, and made sure the model stays even truer to any reference assets you upload.

So… what does all of that actually mean for you?

It gives you more room to tell your story. With up to 15 seconds to work with, you have more flexibility to create what you need — videos look more cinematic and smooth, offering stronger consistency that keeps objects anchored from start to finish. And when characters speak, the dialogue sounds more fluid and natural.

Creators and everyday users can start directing scenes and multi-turn edits in @FlowbyGoogle, generating 15-second clips at no additional cost in Google Vids, or creating 15-second videos in the @GeminiApp. Plus, for developers and businesses building with the API, we've dropped the price by 30% from the previous generation, making it available at just $0.07 per second for 720p video.

Watch the model in action as it turns a single style frame into a 4-shot, 15-second macro science explainer of a living beehive ↓

See a fully-explorable 3D world build itself in minutes ⛩️

Watch @GoogleDeepMind's @GeokenAI explain how Gemini 4 Argon acts as a virtual builder in @antigravity to autonomously create a stunning, multi-tiered pagoda sanctuary.

Textbook biology, brought to life right in your browser 🌿

This interactive 5-stage visual atlas built by Argon in @antigravity turns dense textbook biology into a hands-on experience. With fluid animations and scientific precision, you can scroll from a sunlit leaf all the way down to sub-cellular chloroplasts.

The model pairs accuracy with a seamless interactive design, demonstrating how to build educational tools that can make complex science visual and effortless to explore.

We’ve been exploring the potential of using Gemini 4 Argon to accelerate research @Google. One of our tests was using videos of humans performing fun tasks (game of bags, anyone?) to autonomously spin up training simulations, rather than relying entirely on manual programming.

Hear from our research team and see the results in action as our humanoid robot studies the videos, runs the simulations, and masters the game of cornhole.

It’s Friday 🎉 Here’s a look at this week’s announcements:

— is now available globally in English, allowing anyone to use our detector portal to easily verify if images, video, or audio files were AI-generated by Google or industry partners
— Nano Banana 2.1, featuring leaps in visual design, subject consistency, and precise spot editing that lets you change specific details without altering the whole image
— EmbeddingGemma 2, our first natively multimodal open model that unifies text, images, video, audio, and code into a single space for on-device embeddings
— @GoogleGemma 4 paired with BOTANIC-1, a specialized AI trained on plant DNA, to rapidly pinpoint the exact mutations that make crops thrive
— Gemini agent for your business, a universal cloud agent running 24/7 to get your work done
— Guided Vision in Gemini Live, offering real-time visual assistance and dynamic audio descriptions via your camera, built alongside the blind and low-vision community

Check out this week's updates and releases:

— Gemini 3.8 Flash TTS and Gemini 3.8 Flash-Lite TTS, two of our most expressive audio generation models yet
— Gemini 3.8 Live with Live Avatar, bringing near real-time visual presence to Gemini’s conversational AI
— @Gemini_Notebook Interactive Learning Overviews, giving all users an interactive hub to combine source summaries and artifacts
— Live Chat on the @Gemini_Notebook mobile app, bringing real-time, hands-free voice conversations across ~100 languages
— Project Suncatcher, our moonshot announced last year, will launch a prototype satellite to test @Google TPUs in orbit and explore solar-powered AI compute in space

It’s time for our end-of-week recap 👇

— Gemini 3.8 Live and 3.8 Live Extended Thinking, our most advanced live dialogue audio models yet
— Dreambeans, an experiment from @GoogleLabs that curates a daily personalized collection of stories, is now GA
— CC from @GoogleLabs has expanded from a personal productivity tool into a shared agent, designed to help families and households coordinate logistics, schedules, and daily tasks
— Google Pics, a new @GoogleWorkspace tool that lets you generate, refine, and co-create images, is now GA
— AlphaGenome Atlas, @GoogleDeepMind's new interactive platform for genomics discovery
